summary: Alerts reach Invardia again, and Tagging Rules is easier to scan.

new.title: Tagging Rules easier to scan
new.text: Rule groups start collapsed, and a search opens what it finds. The value column now says Tag Value, and Matched explains how many accounts a rule matched last run.

new.title: EPS in the header
new.text: The header now shows EPS, with Entra Policy Suite in smaller letters.

fixes.title: Alerts to Invardia are delivered again
fixes.text: For installs that report to Invardia, alerts were refused and the reporting job showed partly failed. Alerts now arrive.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes: clearer Get started text
fixes.text: The mail sender step on Get started no longer reads like a command.
